R_CoreWorlds.name: The Core Worlds
R_CoreWorlds.summary: Crown convergence; wealth, memory, administration, trade, surviving institutions, and dense interdependence. The Core is not culturally uniform and should never be reduced to Meridian alone.

R_BastionSpire.name: Bastion Spire and Crown Orbitals
R_BastionSpire.summary: Fortress, Fleet ceremonial heart, shipyard, market, memorial complex, and transit nexus. Monumentality and ordinary work coexist.

R_Meridian.name: Meridian
R_Meridian.summary: Core trade hub and cultural capital: blue-green world of markets, storms, ritualized commerce, mixed regional culture, and inherited memory of famine beneath present wealth.
